title: Finite-ring realization of the proper/open support identification
statement:
Fix D,C,E,n>=1 and a normalized finite operations datum F [def-sf-operation-stages]. For a quasi-compact map f:X->Y of six-functor spaces, a compactification c=(i:X->Z,g:Z->Y) and a finite constructible input K, the inverse canonical support factor identification followed by F.finiteSupport(f,c) is F.finiteDirectImage(g) followed by ambient proper image of F.finiteOpenExtension(i). This statement is at one finite coefficient ring; it involves neither integral objects nor coefficient systems.

theorem finiteSupportFactorRealization
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (F : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [QuasiCompact f.hom.left] (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X) :
    let Q := identitySquare f c
    (intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible C.l E n hn Y.obj.left).ι.map
        ((sixFunctorFactoredSupportIdentification F.finite Q.i Q.p Q.open_i Q.proper_p
          Q.f Q.factorization).inv.app K) ≫
      (F.finiteSupport f c).hom.app K =
    (F.finiteDirectImage Q.p).hom.app ((F.finite.openExtension Q.i Q.open_i).obj K) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage c.g
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n)).map
          ((F.finiteOpenExtension Q.i Q.open_i).hom.app K)

proof.text: Choose a bounded-below etale-origin witness for inverse coefficient realization using [lem-sf-finite-realization-etale-origin]. Construct the retained RefinementFiniteLevelOrigin and its comparison w with K using refinementFixedWitnessIso and the coefficient counit. Apply finiteCompositionNormalization from [def-sf-operation-stages] to the open and proper identity-factor compactifications. Apply [lem-sf-finite-support-identity-factor-compositor] to this witness. The generic proved cancel_witness lemma cancels the output coefficient comparison, moves w through the proper and open candidate comparisons by naturality, and cancels its image. This yields support_composition_factor, a witness-free equation for the inverse binary composition.

Expand the inverse sixFunctorFactoredSupportIdentification into properIdentity inverse, direct image of openIdentification inverse, and composition inverse. Substitute support_composition_factor. Naturality moves the proper candidate comparison across finiteSupport for the open factor. finiteProperNormalization replaces proper support followed by its candidate comparison by properIdentity followed by finiteDirectImage. finiteOpenNormalization does the analogous replacement for the open factor. The proved generic cancel_factor lemma uses naturality of finiteDirectImage and properIdentity to move openIdentification across these comparisons. The two inverse identity identifications cancel. Apply this generic factor_realization to identitySquare f c; its factor compactification is the prescribed c. All signatures remain unchanged.
